market.what: Refined germanium (metal + GeO2), world, primary + recycled
market.method: ~230 t/yr (145 t China) x ~$3,000/kg blend (2025 avg GeO2 $2,500, metal $4,100 Europe). Reports say $0.2-0.4B at older prices
market.job_what: recovering Ge from zinc leach residues/solutions (leach + tannin precipitation or SX), world primary
market.job_method: est.: ~160 t/yr primary Ge x ~$300/kg (tannin 11-30 g/g Ge x $4-5.5/kg = ~$60-150/kg + leach/roast ~$150-250/kg est.) = ~$50M; low confidence

value.logic: ex-China Ge from zinc circuits by 2032 est. 100 t (Korea Zinc 44, Teck doubling, Titan 13, Nyrstar Hobart). +15 pts recovery (~18 t) x $4,000/kg = $72M + less tannin/reagent ~$8M
value.revenue_logic: 40% share x 100 t Ge x ~$120/kg (3% of Ge value) extractant + licence

trend.drivers: fiber for AI data centers, defense IR optics, satellite solar cells; China export licences 2023, US ban Dec 2024; price +~2x 2024-25
trend.deadline: 27 Nov 2026: China's 1-yr suspension of its US Ga/Ge export ban ends

competition.notes: No molecule startups found; field is smelters + grants: Korea Zinc $7.4B Crucible (44 t/yr Ge ~2029), 5N Plus $18.1M (2026), Canada backing Teck Trail expansion. Today: tannin precipitation, LIX 63 or hydroxamic acid SX.

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: chelating extractant (hydroxamic/oxime type, est.), 3 variants
lab.test: Batch D vs acid, Ge/Fe/Zn/As selectivity, NaOH strip, synthetic + real zinc leach (Ge 0.1-0.5 g/L, Fe 10-30 g/L) vs LIX 63; ICP-OES/ICP-MS
lab.logic: synth 6 wk, 3 x ~$5k = $15k + test 4 wk: ~150 ICP x $50 = ~$7.5k + feeds ~$2.5k

sale.gates: smelter bench + pilot SX on a bleed stream 6-12 mo; Ge concentrate spec accepted by refiner (Umicore/5N Plus)
